releaseNotes:
- Complete ground-up rewrite in modern native C++20 for instant startup and maximum responsiveness
- 93% smaller memory footprint and zero external dependencies (no .NET runtime required)
- Hardware-accelerated Direct2D / DirectComposition capture and rendering pipeline
- Native Windows OCR text extraction and AVX2-accelerated pixel sampling
- Compact and space-saving real-time Color Picker HUD with instant hex copying
- Seamless settings migration preserving all custom hotkeys, themes, and preferences
